description: Looks up an Indian company or LLP in the Ministry of Corporate Affairs' company master data on data.gov.in: name, type, incorporation date, MCA status and Registrar of Companies. Feed the type and date into compliance_calendar. The dataset runs a few months behind MCA, so a company set up recently may not be found.
name: company_lookup
title: Indian company or LLP lookup by CIN or LLPIN
